title: Bill of Rights
blurb: Click a Bill of Rights amendment, then its protection, to lock in a match.

items.right: Freedom of speech, religion, press, assembly, and petition
Right to keep and bear arms
Protection from being forced to house soldiers
Protection from unreasonable searches and seizures
Rights of due process, protection from self-incrimination, and double jeopardy
Right to a speedy public trial, lawyer, and impartial jury
Right to a jury trial in certain civil cases
Protection from excessive bail, fines, and cruel punishment
Rights exist beyond those specifically listed in the Constitution
Powers not given to the federal government belong to states or the people
